hypothesis: At the last encoder FFN, explicit previous-prefix content in a nonlinear observed-lag filter can reduce the RMSE/MAE tradeoff compared with a same-parameter current-prefix nonlinear expansion.
evidence_strength: Architecture and unresolved tradeoff justify a bounded controlled hypothesis; no evidence establishing that FFN is defective or that the proposed intervention will improve performance.
placement: encoder.layers[1] FFN, after its attention residual and norm2; before existing first GELU; existing W1/W2 remain

formula.C: sum(l=0..2, A[t,l] * c[l] * GELU(a[l] * u[source(t,l)] + b[l])) / 3
formula.output: existing W2(existing dropout(existing GELU(u+C))) followed by unchanged external drop2/residual/mask
formula.channel_mixing: Only original W1/W2 mix channels; C is channelwise nonlinear observed-lag filtering, not a new cross-channel operator.

initialization.broadcast: each scalar repeated for 128 expanded channels
initialization.offset_meaning: dimensionless fixed design constants, not estimated mean/std or optimized hyperparameters
initialization.gradient_note: At c=0 initial task gradients into a/b are zero; c learns directly. AdamW decoupled weight decay may update a/b from first step. Verify generic subsequent gradient activation, not universally nonzero gradients.

observation_contract.padding: skip padded positions in lag counting
observation_contract.withheld_valid: reset eligibility only for new local FFN gather; original attention can retain earlier visible-prefix information
observation_contract.availability: exact same A for both arms; constant divisor3 even when fewer taps available
observation_contract.safe_values: where-mask unobserved values before gather, mask absent branches after GELU, reject nonfinite observed u/learned parameters/intermediates
observation_contract.future: no future event/target is a local source

unchanged: original Q/K/V local filters and normal common projection training
training budget/optimizer/scheduler/batch and seed selection policy
interpretation_limits: Current-only uses an attention-prefix hidden and availability; it is not a history-free model.
Equal registered/trainable counts do not prove equal function space or optimization difficulty.
Common weights including QKV and head are trainable; their learned values/attention may change.
The downstream Hard-LMM may retrieve different prototypes; memory functional influence is not held fixed.
Applying nonlinear temporal processing at this location is not a novel principle or the first use of temporal-channel interactions in this project.
selection: first strictly finite fullValidation raw quantity RMSE minimum epoch; first epoch for ties

decision.user_performance_gate: For each arm all four Validation/Test mean RMSE/MAE strictly below both saved CNN and same-target external per-metric best.
decision.mechanism_evidence: Temporal minus Current mean RMSE and MAE must both be negative in Validation; confirm Test differences separately. Temporal contribution across splits requires both metrics lower in both splits. Preserve every seed exception and time/tail deterioration.
decision.expansion: Among arms passing user gate, choose Validation mean RMSE then MAE then exact arm lexical order. Test eligibility is selection use. If Current is chosen describe a pointwise FFN expansion, not explicit temporal-content success.
decision.failure: Preserve results; do not claim cause or expand failing models; next evidence-based backbone hypothesis only.
